description: This is a PHP source file defining an admin controller class for managing customer reports in an OpenCart module. It includes methods for displaying the report form, saving configuration, generating report data, and rendering report views.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for customer report management in the OpenCart admin panel, extending core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer report page, loads language and view components, and sets up breadcrumbs and configurations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves report configuration settings after permission check, returns success or error in JSON format.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the customer report view with data grouped by year, month, week, or day.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer report data list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and prepares customer report data, including filtering, pagination, and loading the report view.
